researched_by: the council's own Motorhomes / Arosfan pages
policy_summary:
The Arosfan network - four dedicated stopovers modelled on continental aires, funded through the Welsh Government's Brilliant Basics programme. GBP16.50 covers 16:00 to 10:00 the following morning; park in the bays during the day and the normal car park tariff applies on top. Two nights maximum, self-contained vehicles only.

Motorhomes may park in any Gwynedd car park during the day, but sleeping overnight is permitted ONLY in the Arosfan bays. Parking outside a designated bay risks a penalty charge notice.

The council is explicit about what these are not: 'as motor homes are self-contained, the aim of the Arosfan sites is not to provide a camping facility'.

Introduced alongside the sites were specific orders preventing overnight motorhome parking in lay-bys in the areas worst affected - provision and enforcement together, as in South Ayrshire.
notes: Widely regarded as the closest thing the UK has to a European aire network. Facilities are not uniform: chemical and grey waste disposal at Criccieth, Pwllheli and Llanberis; fresh water at Criccieth, Caernarfon and Pwllheli. Caernarfon has water but no waste point, which matters if you are planning a route around it.
open_questions: Which lay-bys are covered by the orders? The council names none.
Has a Meirionnydd site been found? Work was continuing as of 2023.
Full list of car parks with height barriers - the council mentions them without listing them.

sites.notes: Doc Fictoria car park, the old Shell site. GBP16.50 covers 16:00-10:00 only; the normal car park tariff applies if you are in the bay between 10:00 and 16:00.

sites.notes: Y Glyn car park beside Llyn Padarn, the area known locally as the lagoons. Nine bays were in the original planning application. GBP16.50 covers 16:00-10:00 only; the normal car park tariff applies if you are in the bay between 10:00 and 16:00.

sites.name: All other Gwynedd council car parks
sites.notes: Daytime parking is fine anywhere. Sleeping overnight is permitted only in the Arosfan bays. Height barriers at some car parks exclude larger motorhomes; the council does not list which.

sites.name: Lay-bys in the worst-affected areas, county-wide
sites.notes: Specific orders introduced alongside the Arosfan sites to remove the right of motorhomes to park overnight in lay-bys where problems were worst. HIGH PRIORITY GAP: the council has not published which lay-bys. Lay-bys are where vans actually stop, so this is the most valuable missing piece in the record.
